summary: Tested Interactive Trap Practice feature in Opening Training Lab. All tests pass (14 frontend E2E + 17 backend API). Feature is fully functional: Traps tab displays trap list with metadata, clicking trap opens TrapPractice component with 3-phase workflow (Setup → Execute Trap → Victory), setup moves play automatically, hint/reset buttons work correctly, and close button returns to trap list.
seed_data_creation: N/A - Used existing opening lesson data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interactive Trap Practice feature fully tested. Test URL: /openings/italian-game then click Traps tab. The TrapPractice component is client-side only - it uses trap data from opening lesson, no separate backend API for trap practice. Key test IDs: trap-card-0 through trap-card-N for trap cards. Italian Game has 4 traps: Fried Liver Attack, Legal's Mate, Blackburne Shilling Gambit, Scholar's Mate Defense Trap.

trapsTabDisplay: Traps tab shows count badge (e.g., '4' for Italian Game)
Clicking tab shows instruction text and trap cards
Trap cards have data-testid='trap-card-N' for testing
trapCardMetadata: Shows difficulty badge with color (beginner=green, intermediate=amber, advanced=red)
Shows result type badge (checkmate, wins material, etc.)
trapPracticeComponent: Shows 'Practice: {trap name}' header with close button
Shows phase indicators: 1. Setup > 2. Execute Trap > 3. Victory!
Shows chessboard oriented for user's color
trapPracticePhases: Ready phase: Shows Start Practice button and trap info
Setup phase: Shows 'Setting up position...' while moves play automatically
Trap phase: Shows Hint and Reset buttons, user can make moves
Complete phase: Shows Practice Again button (after Victory)
trapPracticeControls: Start Practice button initiates setup phase
Hint button shows move explanations (blue feedback)
Reset button returns to ready state
Close (X) button returns to trap list
backendAPIs: GET /api/openings/{key} - includes traps array in opening data
POST /api/traps/suggest - finds trap from move sequence
